name: d-01-two-area-survey
description: two independent modules to survey — delegation is the efficient path; measures whether the model splits the work
prompt: Survey error handling in the workspace: lib/parser.cpp and tui/scroll.cpp. For each module report how it treats invalid input and how strict it is, then compare the two. Splitting the two surveys into separate task calls lets each worker focus on one module — you may delegate them. Name both modules in your final reply.
